markerNotes: group 1: the revocation search of L91: the fixed line asc-merge-grant-revoked by name, or the search named in words (取消し/取り消し with the ok-gana variants, 定型行・検索・有無・記録・コメント), or the statement that the search cannot be run here (検索/照合 + できない/行えない/実行できない and polite forms). Any of the three shows the procedure of L91 (search, or cannot search -> default stage).

group 2: the outcome L91 requires when the search cannot be run in this session. Only a stop or an ask passes: the default stage stated as the result (既定/デフォルトの段階 + に戻る/とする/として/のまま/にする/に従う/で扱う, or Issueごと named as the default stage in the same way), not merging now (merge/マージ + せず/しない/しません/行わない/行いません/実行しない/保留/控え/待つ/止める, polite and spelling variants), or asking the user for the permission (許可/承認 + を求め/いただ/お願い). Bare 許可を得る/確認/もらう/ください/許可が必要 and a mention of a permission alone do not pass, so that 「Issueごとの許可を得ているのでmergeする」 or 「merge許可を確認してmergeを実行する」 fails.

scoring.readCounts: fixture A cases (#1817): a Read counts only when its tool_result exists and is not is_error. design cases (stopped by --max-turns 3): a Read counts when its tool_result is not is_error or is absent because the run stopped after that message (issued, as stage 1); resultMissing is recorded
scoring.entryHop: first hop: the expected Skill called via the Skill tool (name equals the Skill or ends with :<skill>) or its thin entry .claude/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md Read
scoring.bodyRead: second hop: the expected body .agent-skill-chain/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md Read (the entry only links to it)
scoring.referenceRead: any listed reference of the expected Skill Read (true when none listed)
scoring.markers: #1817 for fixture A cases (all answerAll substrings, one answerAny when listed, every answerGroups regex, case-insensitive, on the final result text). design cases have no markers (the run is stopped before the answer): markers is true by definition and recorded as markersApplicable false
scoring.applied: bodyRead and referenceRead and markers. design cases: the asc body and at least one of implementation.md or workspace.md read within the first three messages. scenario cases: the asc body, the reference that holds the rule for the condition (referencesByCondition: none in B, where the body holds it; the reference named in referencesByCondition in S: merge-permission.md, merge-grant.md or decision-handling.md) and every answerGroups regex
scoring.misselect: expected not reached and another Skill was called or another ASC entry or body was Read
scoring.unselected: no Skill call and no ASC entry or body Read
scoring.secondaryRead: for each secondary Skill, whether its body was Read (recorded, not used for pass/fail)
scoring.overapplication: negative case with any ASC Skill call or any ASC entry or body Read (bundled Host Skills are recorded separately)
scoring.stopped: a per-trial budget stop or the --max-turns stop of a design case is a completed observation, scored on what was issued before it and flagged
scoring.failure: process error, API error or missing trace; counted separately, never as unselected or passed
scoring.designFacts: design cases also record the message (1..3) of the first body read, Skill(asc), and whether a Write or Edit was issued before the body read (recorded, not scored)
scoring.condition: a trial whose init event shows other tools than level W (ToolSearch tolerated), another permission mode than acceptEdits, or an MCP server did not receive the condition and is a failure (stage 1 rule)
scoring.scenario: kind scenario: an app fixture variant and a prompt asking for the procedure; scored like a fixture A case (full run, markers on the final answer). Recorded too: ascReferencesRead (which asc references were read), markersWithoutReference (the markers matched although the reference that holds the rule in that condition was not read: in S, the rule was applied from the SKILL.md entry text, not from the reference)
scoring.efficiency: every trial records ascBytesRead (bytes of the distinct ASC files read: entries, bodies and references under .agent-skill-chain/ or .claude/skills/, sizes from the trial work/ copy; a partial Read counts the whole file), inputTokens (input + cache read + cache write) and durationMs
